Taylor: Quick postmortem follow-up — we need a compact thread to track outstanding action items from last night's OOM. Root cause looked like rapid KV-slot churn combined with small-object heap fragmentation. I'll list owners and proposed ETAs; please ack and adjust.
Maya: Ack, I'll take profiling and artifacts.
Taylor: Actions (initial plan):
  - Maya: end-to-end allocation profiling (flamegraphs + heap snapshots) on the replay trace under 1hr sustained load — ETA: Tue EOD.
  - Samir: eviction-policy experiments (LRU / segmented / time-decay) and add a dashboard with eviction / live-alloc / resident-size metrics — ETA: next Thu.
  - Eli: GC/jemalloc tuning and background compaction schedule; evaluate fragmentation reduction and CPU cost — ETA: Mon.
  - infra-bot: create tracking tickets, attach last-night logs and OOM traces.
Samir: +1. Planning to run experiments on staging GPU nodes (stg-gpu-2) tomorrow morning, will reuse the replay trace.
Maya: I'll run `python tools/alloc_prof.py --duration 3600 --out=alloc_profile_tue` and produce flamegraph + condensed heap diff. If anyone has a shorter reproducer, drop it here.
Taylor: I have a 15m replay snippet that amplifies the churn — I'll upload to the ticket.
infra-bot: Created tickets: INF-3245 (alloc-profiling), INF-3246 (eviction-experiments), INF-3247 (gc-tuning). Links: https://jira.redwood/INF-3245, https://jira.redwood/INF-3246, https://jira.redwood/INF-3247 :link: \noncall: Quick ops note — please set a conservative throttle/oom-alert while running noisy experiments or we will end up paging SRE.
Eli: Will add temporary alert bump and a canary rollout plan for compaction changes. Also planning to run `jeprof` + `jemalloc --stats_print` after stress runs to capture fragmentation maps.
Maya: Heads up: sampling profilers miss very short-lived tiny allocations. I'll include both sampling and deterministic heap snapshots where feasible.
Samir: For eviction tuning I'll start with `segment_size=64k` and `max_fill=0.75`, measure hit-rate and active-resident change. If not enough, try more aggressive background cleaning and a smaller segment size.
Taylor: Can we set a recurring sync for progress tracking? Propose weekly check-ins for 3 weeks, close or escalate by Apr 10. I'll schedule Thu 09:00 PST recurring.
Maya: Acked :white_check_mark:
Eli: Acked.
Samir: Acked.
Taylor: Please update the Jira tickets INF-3245/INF-3246/INF-3247 with one-line daily progress. Ping me when the first flamegraph is ready so we can decide next experiments.
infra-bot: Calendar invite created: "KV eviction & fragmentation check-in" Thu 09:00 PST, invite sent to Taylor, Maya, Samir, Eli. Reminder will post 30m prior.
Taylor: Thanks team — main goals: (1) reproduce and root-cause the fragmentation pattern, (2) validate eviction changes don't regress latency, (3) land conservative mitigations by Apr 10. If anyone hits blockers, post here and tag me.
Maya: Will post initial flamegraph by EOD Tue.
Samir: Will post staging run results by Wed.
Eli: Will test compaction change in canary on Mon and report perf/cost impact.
 oncall: Noted — will coordinate on alert thresholds during experiments.
